Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ's):
1. What tests are included in the Thyrocare UTSH-LH-FSH-PRL Hormone Panel?
The Thyrocare TSH-LH-FSH-PRL Hormone Panel consists of four important hormone tests that are essential for evaluating thyroid health, reproductive hormones, and pituitary gland function. The panel includes TSH (Thyroid Stimulating Hormone), LH (Luteinizing Hormone), FSH (Follicle Stimulating Hormone), and PRL (Prolactin). These hormones play a crucial role in regulating menstrual cycles, ovulation, fertility, and thyroid activity. All tests are processed using advanced technology in Thyrocare’s NABL and ISO-certified automated laboratories, ensuring accurate and dependable results.
2. Who should opt for the Thyrocare TSH-LH-FSH-PRL test?
This test panel is recommended for women experiencing menstrual irregularities, fertility issues, delayed puberty, or symptoms related to hormonal imbalance. It is also suitable for individuals undergoing assisted reproductive therapy, or for those with suspected thyroid dysfunction or pituitary gland disorders. The Thyrocare TSH-LH-FSH-PRL Hormone Panel provides detailed insight into the hormonal health of individuals and is useful for both routine evaluation and diagnostic follow-up.
3. Is fasting required before taking the Thyrocare UTSH-LH-FSH-PRL test?
Fasting is not required for this test panel. A blood sample can be collected at any time of the day. Since these tests are based on hormone levels and not glucose or lipid profiles, there is no need to fast prior to the sample collection, making it a convenient choice for many individuals.
4. How is the sample collected for the Thyrocare UTSH-LH-FSH-PRL test?
Thyrocare provides free home sample collection across India. Once the test is booked, a trained phlebotomist visits your home to collect the blood sample under hygienic conditions. The sample is then sent to Thyrocare’s centralized automated laboratory, where testing is conducted using high-end diagnostic equipment to ensure precision, consistency, and fast report turnaround.
5. What is the cost of the Thyrocare TSH-LH-FSH-PRL Hormone Panel?
The Thyrocare TSH-LH-FSH-PRL Hormone Panel is priced at Rs 1,299. This cost includes all four hormone tests, free doorstep sample collection, and digital delivery of the report via SMS and email. The package provides great value for anyone seeking a complete hormone profile at an affordable rate.
6. When will I receive the test report from Thyrocare?
You will typically receive your Thyrocare hormone test report within 24 to 48 hours of sample collection. The report is delivered digitally through email and SMS, offering fast and convenient access to your test results for consultation with your healthcare provider.
7. Why choose Thyrocare for hormone testing?
Thyrocare is a trusted name in preventive health diagnostics, offering fully automated and certified laboratory testing with a nationwide network. With more than two decades of experience, Thyrocare ensures quality service through accurate testing, quick turnaround, and reliable home sample collection. The TSH-LH-FSH-PRL Hormone Panel is a targeted solution for understanding reproductive and endocrine health, making it a valuable choice for proactive medical care.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ's):
Q: What is the Thyrocare Thyroid Basic Profile?
Ans.
The Thyroid Basic Profile is a diagnostic test designed to evaluate thyroid gland function and detect thyroid-related disorders. It includes 5 parameters that go beyond basic TSH testing by incorporating ultra-sensitive TSH, which offers greater accuracy and precision. This profile also checks important health indicators , helping provide a more comprehensive overview of your metabolic and hormonal health.
Q: What is the role of ultrasensitive TSH in this test?
Ans.
Ultrasensitive TSH (uTSH) testing is more refined than standard TSH and can detect even slight changes in thyroid hormone levels. It helps in identifying early or borderline cases of hypothyroidism and hyperthyroidism, which may go unnoticed with regular testing. This makes it particularly useful for individuals with vague symptoms or those under thyroid treatment.
Q: Why should someone get this profile done?
Ans.
This test is recommended for individuals showing symptoms of thyroid dysfunction such as fatigue, unexplained weight gain or loss, hair thinning, mood swings, irregular menstrual cycles, or sensitivity to cold or heat. It also helps monitor thyroid conditions in people already diagnosed or on medication. Additionally, the inclusion of cardiac and vitamin markers gives insights into related health risks and deficiencies.
Q: Who should take this test?
Ans.
This profile is ideal for anyone experiencing symptoms of thyroid imbalance, those with a family history of thyroid disease, women above 30, or individuals with chronic fatigue, weight fluctuations, or depression. It is also beneficial for regular health monitoring in patients on thyroid medication.
Q: Is fasting required before this test?
Ans.
No fasting is necessary for the Thyroid Basic Profile. However, you should inform the lab about any ongoing medication or supplements that could influence thyroid or vitamin levels.
Q: How is the sample collected?
Ans.
A certified technician from Thyrocare will collect your blood sample from home. BookMyTest offers free home sample collection, making it convenient and safe.
Q: When will I receive the reports?
Ans.
The reports are typically available within 24 to 48 hours. They are shared via email, WhatsApp, and also uploaded to your BookMyTest account.
Q: What is the cost of the Thyroid Basic Profile?
Ans.
This profile is available at an affordable price and includes free home sample collection. Visit www.bookmytest.co.in to check the latest price and book your test.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ's):
1. What is included in Thyroid Profile Advanced by Thyrocare?
Thyroid Profile Advanced by Thyrocare includes important thyroid function tests such as TSH, T3, T4, Free T3, Free T4, and other thyroid hormone parameters used for advanced thyroid health evaluation.
2. Why should I take Thyroid Profile Advanced by Thyrocare?
Thyrocare Thyroid Profile Advanced helps detect hypothyroidism, hyperthyroidism, thyroid hormone imbalance, and metabolic disorders at an early stage for better health management.
3. Does Thyroid Profile Advanced include TSH, T3 and T4 tests?
Yes, Thyrocare Thyroid Profile Advanced includes TSH, T3, T4, Free T3, and Free T4 tests for comprehensive thyroid hormone assessment.
4. Can I book Thyroid Profile Advanced online with home collection?
Yes, you can book Thyroid Profile Advanced by Thyrocare online with free home sample collection. It is suitable for users searching for thyroid blood test near me or thyroid test at home.
5. Who should take Thyroid Profile Advanced by Thyrocare?
This Thyrocare thyroid screening package is recommended for individuals experiencing fatigue, weight gain, hair fall, weakness, mood swings, irregular periods, thyroid symptoms, or family history of thyroid disorders.
6. Is fasting required for Thyroid Profile Advanced test?
Fasting is generally not required for most tests included in Thyrocare Thyroid Profile Advanced. However, follow the instructions provided before sample collection.
7. How long does it take to get Thyroid Profile Advanced reports?
Reports for Thyrocare Thyroid Profile Advanced are usually available within 24 to 48 hours after sample collection, depending on processing time and location.
8. Why is thyroid testing important?
Thyroid testing by Thyrocare helps monitor thyroid hormone balance and detect thyroid disorders early, which may affect metabolism, energy levels, weight, hair health, and overall wellness.
